name: Mátételke (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged near the top with the municipal arms of Mátételke (a crowned blue shield with a figure and a red lion, with red and blue mantling) above the name MÁTÉTELKE in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Mátételke arms with crown and mantling
